definitions.BU: Benign task success; headline is an equal-weight mean over 12 model-suite cells.
definitions.UAU: Task success under attack; headline is an equal-weight 12-cell mean, not pooled 1533/2847.
definitions.ASR: Family-specific original reported executed-effect numerator/denominator; macro and pooled remain separate.
definitions.ERS_BU: Harmonic mean of BU and1-ASR; original zero convention.
definitions.rounding: exact frozen paper.f3/r3; Table2 composites from printed12-cellmeans; Table4 per-suite composites then mean

disclosures: Only this 54-condition single-artifact scope was rerun; other defenses, AgentDyn, all ablations and additional seeds were not rerun.
PISmith is open-loop released-cache variant0 ASR@1; it has nonzero reported effects on both backbones.
The original paper and old benchmark caches are preserved; this summary does not replace them.

The Slack missing-argument evaluator guard, explicit known repeat-abort terminal, and strict preprovider/auxiliary overflow readers were reviewed with the actual source/provenance and final strict-join receipts. These runtime amendments are disclosed, not an unchanged evaluation implementation.
An adapter terminal is not a model response; original three logical failures and unknown failed-attempt usage remain telemetry.
Paid composite adopts strictly audited serial sources and delegated serial subshards; no fabricated flat serial trace or duplicate canonical cell.
Known overflows remain in attempted denominators. Native auxiliary episodes are preserved outside target denominators.
No new tail-latency, phone, throughput, invoice-total or paired-significance claim is made.
